usage.callShape: POST https://www.surplusintelligence.ai/x402/api/inference/v1/chat/completions with JSON body {model, messages, max_tokens?, stream?}
quirks: Backend is Venice-based: response includes a venice_parameters object alongside standard OpenAI fields.
Required body fields: model and messages. model example llama-3.3-70b works.
Prompt token count is inflated (~1689 prompt_tokens for 'hello') because an implicit system prompt is prepended; flat per-request x402 price ($0.0033) is unaffected.
usage.guide: Call POST https://www.surplusintelligence.ai/x402/api/inference/v1/chat/completions with an OpenAI-style JSON body containing "model" (e.g. "llama-3.3-70b") and "messages" (array of {role, content}). Optionally set max_tokens and stream. Pay via x402 on Base (~$0.0033 flat per request). Read the assistant reply at body.choices[0].message.content. Token usage is in body.usage.
